title: Battle of Blenheim
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Blenheim", at revision 1382246566, opens: "The Battle of Blenheim fought on 13 August [O.S. 2 August] 1704, was a major battle of the War of the Spanish Succession. The overwhelming Allied victory ensured the safety of Vienna from the Franco-Bavarian army, thus preventing the collapse of the reconstituted Grand Alliance." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q154635, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1704 major battle of the War of the Spanish Succession". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
